cases.scope: Equivalence of select-of-add and add-of-select requires symbolic congruence across shared arithmetic, not merely same-condition arm elimination.
Complementary comparisons are canonical zero/one values, not bitwise word complements. The word truth-table synthesizer cannot substitute NOT without a Boolean-only proof.
Threading a shift through a select needs proof that both per-arm shifts fold and all counts are valid. Variable operations are not cloned.
Eliminating x-1 under x!=0 needs inequality/path nonzero intervals; a generic unsigned decrement wraps at zero.
LLVM poison/freeze semantics differ from LCCC total eager integer operations. Removing IsLogical guards globally is not a local source rewrite.
Coalescing a Boolean comparison mux into x==select needs CFG/Boolean provenance and a target cost decision; no eager evaluation of short-circuit effects.
Reordering two independent select conditions requires decision-tree construction and sharing costs; direct same/inverse-condition substitution does not cover it.
The motivating nested logical condition is composite, not the same predicate as its outer select; needs Boolean implication beyond the current local relation.
Three-input LEA formation is x86 microarchitecture and instruction-encoding policy, not a target-neutral scalar-select identity.
LLVM load range {0,2} and i1 trunc semantics are not arbitrary scalar truthiness; no missing range metadata is fabricated.
Constant-choice scalar binop with a same-condition zero/one Boolean folds both constant outcomes; sext(i1) and cross-width signed-mask variants are not claimed.
Sinking a shared select across branch/call boundaries needs CFG dominance and effect checks; local consumer substitution does not relocate definitions.
Implication across several ordered comparisons needs a relational interval/constraint solver, not merely exact predicate complement matching.
